data.clinical_information: 58-year-old female with cough and weight loss.

mediastinum.text: Mediastinum shows mildly prominent bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy

pneumonia.text: Left upper lobe consolidation with volume loss, concerning for post-obstructive pneumonia

mass.text: A 3 cm left hilar mass is noted

fracture.text: Pathologic fracture of the left 5th rib posteriorly with associated soft tissue mass, suspicious for metastasis

data.impression: 1. Left hilar mass with left upper lobe consolidation, concerning for malignancy with post-obstructive pneumonia. 2. Pathologic left 5th rib fracture, suspicious for metastatic disease. 3. Small left pleural effusion. 4. Bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy.
